title: Interesting walk and if it is at sunset the photos turn out spectacular.
text: If you want to be on the top part in the open to be able to see everything better, you have to go early to get a good spot.
author: Oscar_V

title: A top-notch ride along the Guadalquivir ☀️☀️☀️
text: We loved the boat ride! We saw it pass by as soon as we arrived in Seville and bought the tickets on their website! Super good and the staff's service was great! Very attentive! We will recommend it! :)
author: marvallem

title: Super experience
text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

An incredible experience from beginning to end. We have thoroughly enjoyed the family boat trip on the Guadalquivir River with my two daughters, and we could not be more grateful for the treatment we received.

We want to especially highlight José, the captain, José, the sailor, and Leo, the sailor, because the three of them have been absolutely charming. They treated us in an exquisite, warm, and super friendly way, making us feel very comfortable and at ease from the very first moment.
